confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Medellin price levels, not live listings or inspected booking pages. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are the most reliable; accommodation anchors are less certain and could drift by 20-30 percent. Cocktail and wine were set from the local price relationship to beer (cocktail about 2.8x beer, wine about 2.6x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. FX provenance: the search tool did not return the rba.gov.au table itself. The 0.6947 value for 2026-10-16 came from a third-party page that attributes it to the RBA, and the 0.6955 figure for 2026-10-15 came from a snippet of the RBA homepage. The source_url is the canonical RBA page but was not read directly. Verify the rate on the RBA F11.1 table before use. The RBA publishes around 4pm Sydney time, so the 2026-10-16 observation may not have been published yet when this was generated.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Anchors use a regional basis: Colombian restaurant and bar price levels, adjusted for Medellin's tourist-oriented districts, and mid-sized Latin American cities with similar visitor service pricing. Bogota is a slightly higher-priced reference; Cali and other Colombian mid-sized cities are lower-priced references.
